runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **CAD 16.27** (TSX close 2026-10-15, `tools/run.py --quote NOA.TO`, aggregator, flagged; the NYSE line USD 11.46 not used, the earnings currency being the Canadian dollar). Shares: 26,829,072 net at 2026-06-30 (27,710,462 issued less 881,390 held by the RSU/PSU trust, June 2026 quarter 6-K 0001368519-26-000013; `Screens/cover_shares.py` read the issued 28,821,481 at 2025-12-31 from the 40-F); market cap CAD 436.5M. Sovereign **4.19%** (Government of Canada long-term benchmark, Bank of Canada series BD.CDN.LONG.DQ.YLD, 2026-10-14, taken by hand: the protocol's table has no CAD row and `tools/sources.py` no CAD source). Filing read: 40-F FY2025, 0001368519-26-000005 (AIF exhibit 99.2, statements 99.3, MD&A 99.4), operating cash FY2025 CAD 264,089K cross-checked against the filed statement; the FY2021 to FY2023 40-Fs, the June 2026 quarter 6-K and the 2026 6-Ks on the CAD 200M 7.00% notes, an ML Northern award, Nuna and the CEO appointment. The brief departed in two stated places: the analyst derived the lines of evidence (nine, stated in the run file), and the 40-F's exhibits stood in for Items 1, 1A and 7. Q1 IN (a fleet of about 1,155 heavy-equipment units hired out to surface mines at bid rates, 85% of 2025 revenue time-and-materials; economics readable without commodity forecasts). **Q2 OUT**: a standing castle that protects only ordinary returns: Heavy Equipment - Canada decides as the largest part over five years (segment gross profit used for the parts test, a CONVENTION of the run); work won by formal competitive bid, customers widening bid lists "to achieve lower pricing" and able to insource, scope cut without cause, Australian clients able to buy out the equipment, CAD 8.0M of booked revenue given back in 2024 for an extension, four customers 68% of 2025 revenue; operating income about 5.9% of total assets over 2016 to 2025 (6.9% with joint-venture earnings, best year 9.0% in 2024), about 4.5% to 5.3% after tax against a 6.4% cash cost of debt, against Granite 2.7%, NACCO 5.1% and Sterling 8.7% (the filings name no rival; the three taken as a CONVENTION of the run); not shown the low-cost operator. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** three chief executives in 2026 (Lambert resigned 2026-01-20, Palmer interim, Rogers from 2026-12-01); guidance published and raised and adjusted figures featured, including a pre-ownership IMC "economic benefit" added to non-GAAP results; CAD 20.6M of Fargo joint-venture write-downs in 2025; no regulator investigation found in the documents read; the management information circular not read. Balance sheets 2016 to 2025: assets up 5.2 times, equity up 2.9 times, debt the difference; borrowings CAD 1,180M at 2026-06-30; goodwill negligible, MacKellar paid largely in assumed debt (CAD 203.9M) and contingent and deferred obligations; retained earnings from a CAD 130M deficit to CAD 176M; a growing deferred tax liability. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash 2021 to 2025 averaging CAD 51.3M after interest and CAD 83.0M all-equity on the filer's sustaining capital, CAD 2.5M after all capital spending, negative in 2024 and 2025; a serial acquirer, so the organic pair central, with organic growth carried at nil as a CONVENTION of the run (the filer reports none); value **CAD 33.33** a share all-equity, the no-growth case alone (default pair 33.33 to 141.61 beside; equity-only 45.60); fair price about **CAD -9.58 all-equity** (CAD 19.11 equity-only; the default pair's 2.45 beside), the business worth about CAD 830M at ten percent against net debt of CAD 1,087M; not armed, the box being OUT at Q2. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session-start commit subjects (the KGS fold) and git status (AYI and ARCB folder names), and a `Test Runs/` listing filtered to today's date showing twelve other run file names (HMH, INVX, KGS, NESR, NGS, NOV, OIS, OMSE, PED, RCON, SEI, USAC), none opened, none about NOA; the analyst ticked the blind-rule box as not fully kept. Commits 497b28f8, f4bbea15, 442e15db, 833a86ab, four. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for NOA). Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` PASS; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_quote_check.py` 31 ids, no phantom, no E-id, 31 quoted fragments checked, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the serial-acquirer rule where the filer reports no organic growth (nil, a proxy, or the default pair central; the choice moves the central fair price from -9.58 to 2.45); (2) the parts rule's measure where the segment measure is gross profit and the window's first year has no segment note; (3) how a negative all-equity fair price is reported or alerted; (4) no CAD row in the protocol's sovereign table and no CAD source in `tools/sources.py`. Could not get: the management information circular, any organic-growth figure, the 2021 segment split (whether Canada passes half depends on it, which part is largest does not).
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a standing castle that protects only ordinary returns; Heavy Equipment - Canada decides, contract mining won by competitive bid from a few large operators who widen bid lists for lower prices and can insource; operating income about 5.9% of total assets over 2016 to 2025 (best year 9.0%), about 4.5% to 5.3% after tax against a 6.4% cost of debt, inside a field of Granite 2.7%, NACCO 5.1%, Sterling 8.7% (a CONVENTION of the run, the filings naming no rival). Integrity facts recorded, not judged: three chief executives in 2026, guidance and adjusted figures featured, Fargo write-downs. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value CAD 33.33 a share all-equity (organic pair at nil organic growth, a CONVENTION) against CAD 16.27, fair about CAD -9.58 all-equity (CAD 19.11 equity-only), net debt CAD 1,087M against a business worth about CAD 830M at ten percent; not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: the serial-acquirer rule with no reported organic growth; the parts measure where only segment gross profit is reported; a negative fair price; no CAD sovereign row.
